Remove outer brackets if present\n    s = s.strip('[]')\n    if not s:\n        return []\n    \n    # Split by comma\n    parts = s.split(',')\n    tasks = []\n    for p in parts:\n        p = p.strip()\n        if p.isdigit():\n            tasks.append(int(p))\n    return tasks\n\ndef correct_date(date_str):\n    \"\"\"Correct invalid dates.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        d = datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m-%d')\n        return d.date()\n    except ValueError:\n        # Try to correct - might be 31st of a 30-day month\n        parts = date_str.split('-')\n        year, month, day = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])\n        # Check if month has max 30 days but day=31\n        if day == 31 and month in [4, 6, 9, 11]:\n            return date(year, month, 30)\n        # Handle Feb 29, 30, 31 etc.\n        # For simplicity, use monthrange\n        import calendar\n        max_day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]\n        if day > max_day:\n            return date(year, month, max_day)\n        return None\n\ndef answer():\n    # Load tasks\n    tasks = {}\n    with open('/app/dataset/tasks.csv') as f:\n        reader = csv.DictReader(f)\n        for row in reader:\n            task_id = int(row['task_id'].strip())\n            tasks[task_id] = float(row['pay_per_completion'])\n    \n    # Process timesheet\n    monthly_data = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(lambda: {'hours': 0, 'bonus': 0}))\n    \n    with open('/app/dataset/timesheet.csv') as f:\n        reader = csv.DictReader(f)\n        for row in reader:\n            # Parse date\n            date_str = row['date'].strip()\n            d = correct_date(date_str)\n            if d is None:\n                continue\n            \n            month_key = d.strftime('%Y-%m')\n            \n            # Parse performed tasks and compute bonus\n            tasks_str = row.get('performed_tasks', '').strip()\n            task_ids = parse_performed_tasks(tasks_str)\n            bonus = sum(tasks.get(tid, 0) for tid in task_ids)\n            \n            monthly_data[employee_id][month_key]['hours'] += hours\n            monthly_data[employee_id][month_key]['bonus'] += bonus\n    \n    # Compute salaries\n    result = {}\n    for pesel in employees:\n        if pesel not in monthly_data:\n            continue\n        monthly_salaries = []\n        for month_key in sorted(monthly_data[pesel].keys()):\n            data = monthly_data[pesel][month_key]\n            rate = employees[pesel]['hourly_rate']\n            salary = data['hours'] * rate + data['bonus']\n            monthly_salaries.append(round(salary))\n        if monthly_salaries:\n            result[pesel] = monthly_salaries\n    \n    return result\n```\n\nWait, but I need to think about this more carefully.
